description: ADVANCED LIGHTING RUNG L3b — THE ANCHOR OF THE ANCHOR. L3 pooled the per-locale illuminant estimates into one scene estimate and CORROBORATED the anchor against it, cutting the leak 13/1300 -> 5/1300 — but the residual was SELF-REFERENTIAL: the pool is a CHEBYSHEV CENTRE (a MEDOID), so Ghat IS some locale's own ghat, that locale's deviation is EXACTLY 0, and it corroborates UNCONDITIONALLY. All five surviving leaks sat exactly there. The white-patch assumption had been PUSHED UP ONE LEVEL, not eliminated. This rung audits SIX candidate certifiers for Ghat and finds exactly ONE that is neither CIRCULAR (the Chebyshev centre; the per-channel MEDIAN, measurably still self-membered on every coherent scene) nor EXTERNAL (temporal persistence assumes stationarity; the dynamic-range ceiling is a white patch under another name and was already killed as NON-LOCAL by the k=1 rung; cone-channel achromaticity assumes an achromatic illuminant and is UNSOUND at the substrate's own landed chromatic gain): LEAVE-ONE-OUT MUTUAL CORROBORATION. l3b_pool_loo forms, PER LOCALE, the Chebyshev centre of EVERY OTHER locale's estimate (the exclusion is Not(Eq(j,loc)), Eq comparing Value::Node by id), so a locale can NEVER be its own certifier — self-membership is broken BY CONSTRUCTION. l3b_corroborate applies L3's OWN envelope, UNCHANGED, against that pool; l3b_recognize is l3_recognize with the corroboration conjunct SWAPPED and nothing else, so L3's own l3_* arm on the SAME graph IS the exact ABLATION and L3b can only ever SUBTRACT claims; l3b_dev writes BOTH deviations as floats so the circularity (dev_cheb identically 0 at the centre) and leave-one-out's own TWIN-LOCALE residual (dev_loo == 0 when two locales share an estimate) are EXHIBITED ON THE GRAPH rather than asserted; l3b_refuse_* make refusal a POSITIVE datum SPLIT BY REASON. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: leave-one-out removes every locale's SELF-certification but does NOT certify the SET — a scene whose locales are all wrong IN THE SAME WAY corroborates unanimously, measured by scaling reflectances by kappa (13/13 corroboration with a recovered Ghat wrong by exactly kappa). CONSTANCY ON THIS SUBSTRATE IS ANCHOR-RELATIVE AND THE ANCHOR IS A DECLARED CHOICE, NOT A MEASUREMENT. NO NEW RUST and NO NEW CONSTANT: the literal set is {0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0e9}, identical to L2's and L3's; the bound is L1's own falls-out ONE LATTICE STEP and the envelope is L3's own, both inherited unchanged with N counted from the data. T3, L1, L1b, L2 and L3 are NOT modified. BOUNDED: MULTI-ILLUMINANT scenes remain unsolved; shadow-vs-reflectance edge attribution is L4's; reflectance is GIVEN at the abstract cone-triple grain; locale-grain registration and adjacency are GIVEN, not grown; IDENTITY correspondence is NOT given. Flag-gated on LightingL3bParams.lighting_l3b, OFF by default (sec 9 — default 0 => byte-identical, seed inert), read ABSENCE-TOLERANTLY via MaxOver(default 0), never PickUnique. See VISION_LIGHTING_L3B_PREREG.md.

rules.name: l3b_pool_loo
rules.comment: THE ANCHOR OF THE ANCHOR. For EACH locale i, forms a scene-level illuminant estimate from EVERY OTHER LOCALE'S estimate and NOT its own: Ghat^(-i) = the Chebyshev centre of {ghat_j : j != i}. WHY: L3's pool is a MEDOID, so Ghat IS some locale's own ghat and that locale's deviation is EXACTLY 0 — it corroborates UNCONDITIONALLY, and all five of L3's surviving leaks sat exactly there. Excluding i from its own pool BREAKS THAT SELF-MEMBERSHIP BY CONSTRUCTION. This is the only one of the six audited candidate certifiers that does so without importing a new assumption (the median is measurably still circular; temporal persistence, the dynamic-range ceiling and cone-channel achromaticity are each an external assumption — a new white patch). The metric, the fold and the Argmin are L3's OWN, reused verbatim; the ONLY change is the SET the fold ranges over. NO new constant. Guarded on Count(others) > 0 so a degenerate single-locale frame REFUSES by never acquiring a leave-one-out estimate rather than folding over an empty set (sec 1.1 — an absence must never read as a value). The l3b_pooled guard makes it fire once per locale so run_rules converges. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3b_dev
rules.comment: Writes BOTH deviations as first-class floats so the audit is a MEASUREMENT and not a claim: l3b_dev_cheb is the locale's deviation from L3's SELF-INCLUDING pool — IDENTICALLY 0 AT THE CHEBYSHEV CENTRE, BY CONSTRUCTION, which is exactly the circularity this rung exists to expose (prereg arm R1, declared ENTAILED: the measurement makes it VISIBLE, it does not make it surprising); l3b_dev_loo is the deviation from the LEAVE-ONE-OUT pool, whose remaining zeros are the TWIN-LOCALE residual (two locales sharing an estimate, so leave-one-out can still return ghat_i) — the honest limit of C3, reported with its count (prereg arm R3). This rule DECIDES NOTHING; it records. Flag-gated, OFF by default.

rules.name: l3b_corroborate
rules.comment: CORROBORATES THE LOCAL ANCHOR AGAINST EVERY OTHER LOCALE BUT ITSELF. L3's corroboration could not refuse its own pool's centre; this one has no centre to be. The envelope is L3's, verbatim. A locale whose anchor is a different MATERIAL from its reference counterpart's produces an estimate the REST of the scene does not support, and is now refused even when it happens to be the scene's medoid. The l3b_corr guard makes it fire once per locale so run_rules converges. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3b_recognize
rules.comment: THE MUTUALLY-CORROBORATED LIGHTING INVARIANT. A surface is recognized iff (a) its locale was PAIRED by L2's join, (b) THE LOCALE'S ANCHOR WAS CORROBORATED BY EVERY OTHER LOCALE BUT ITSELF, and (c) the best candidate in the reference frame's held codebook, rendered at the LOCAL illuminant estimate, lies within ONE LATTICE STEP on every channel. (a) and (c) ARE L3's, TERM FOR TERM — which are L2's, term for term. (b) IS THE ONLY CHANGE, AND IT IS A SWAP, NOT AN ADDITION: l3_corr becomes l3b_corr. THAT IS WHAT MAKES L3's OWN l3_* ARM, READ OFF THE SAME GRAPH IN THE SAME TICK, THE EXACT LEAVE-ONE-OUT ABLATION (sec 13.2) — no duplicate rule ships and the contrast is ONE measurement rather than two experiments. Since (c) is unchanged, L3b remains a SUBSET of L2's verdict and can NEVER widen an invariance class. l3b_ncand records the number of candidates INSIDE the bound (rung L1b's lesson: reporting only the winner's residual hid a bound that never bound). MinOver carries an explicit NO_CANDIDATE default so an EMPTY codebook REFUSES rather than silently admitting (sec 1.1). Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).

rules.name: l3b_refuse_uncorroborated
rules.comment: Marks l3b_status='l3b_refused_uncorroborated' for a surface whose locale was paired and pooled, but whose anchor THE OTHER LOCALES DO NOT CORROBORATE. THIS IS THE RUNG'S OWN CONTRIBUTION MADE VISIBLE — it includes, crucially, the scene's own medoid, which L3's corroboration could not refuse. Splitting refusal BY REASON from refusal by the render's bound means the readback distinguishes 'the others rejected the anchor' from 'the bound rejected the render'. A refusal is a POSITIVE datum (sec 1.1 clause 4): without these rules 'refused' and 'never ran' are indistinguishable. Flag-gated, OFF by default.

rules.name: l3b_refuse_bound
rules.comment: Marks l3b_status='l3b_refused_bound' for a surface whose locale WAS corroborated but whose best rendered candidate exceeds the lattice-step bound. This is L2's own refusal condition, inherited through L3 unchanged; together with l3b_refuse_uncorroborated and l3b_recognize it PARTITIONS every surface whose locale was paired, so the readback is total and no surface silently falls through. Flag-gated, OFF by default (sec 9).
